name: South Node
defines: What already comes easily, and what you can lean on too heavily.

signs.aries: Going it alone is second nature, and you reach for independence and confrontation long after they have stopped working.
signs.taurus: You are unshakeable and self-sufficient, and you stay in comfortable arrangements well past the point of any usefulness.
signs.gemini: Words and quick understanding come to you free, and you use them to stay in the shallows of things that deserve depth.
signs.cancer: Looking after people is automatic, and you fall back on being needed rather than risk being seen as capable.
signs.leo: Performing is effortless, and you retreat into being the one at the centre when what was wanted was a colleague.
signs.virgo: You can take anything apart, and you use analysis and usefulness as a hiding place from the larger question.
signs.libra: Accommodating people costs you nothing visible, and you default to keeping the peace when a position needed taking.
signs.scorpio: Intensity and control are familiar ground, and you reach for both when the situation only ever needed patience.
signs.sagittarius: You can always find a wider perspective, and you use it to get out of the small obligation immediately in front of you.
signs.capricorn: Competence and self-command come easily, and you retreat into work and duty rather than admit to a need.
signs.aquarius: Standing outside is your reflex, and you hold the detached position long after it has quietly become loneliness.
signs.pisces: Sensitivity and escape are your defaults, and you dissolve out of situations that would be better simply faced.
